bg=8
markers=[{4,13,18,24},{1,2,8,11,19},{11,20,23}]
r,c=3,27
grid=[[bg]*c for _ in range(r)]
for i, cols in enumerate(markers):
    for j in cols: grid[i][j]=5
# Fill any strict gaps between marker pairs sharing a row or column.
for i in range(r):
    xs=sorted(markers[i])
    for a,b in zip(xs,xs[1:]):
        for j in range(a+1,b): grid[i][j]=3
for j in range(c):
    ys=[i for i in range(r) if grid[i][j]==5]
    for a,b in zip(ys,ys[1:]):
        for i in range(a+1,b): grid[i][j]=3
print('\n'.join(' '.join(map(str,row)) for row in grid))
print('row lengths:', [len(row) for row in grid])
